description: Directory and parameter fuzzing with ffuf. Target URL must contain 'FUZZ' keyword where the wordlist values are injected. Returns discovered paths/parameters with status codes and sizes.

filter_size.description: Filter out responses of this size (comma-separated)

match_codes.description: Comma-separated HTTP status codes to match

target_url.description: Target URL with FUZZ keyword, e.g. https://example.com/FUZZ

wordlist.description: Wordlist path, or 'common' for built-in SecLists common.txt (default: common)

name: ffuf_fuzz
